## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the smooth bowl with glossy finish down, then put the light blue bowl with darkened rim on top.

Task description: Stack the two bowls, with the smooth glossy bowl on the bottom and the light-blue bowl with a dark rim on top.

Success criteria: The smooth glossy bowl must rest securely below on the table, supporting the lowered light blue bowl with the dark rim above it. Their horizontal positions must approximately coincide, forming a compact stack near the table. Both grippers must be open and release the bowls.

## Execution tips

- The two bowls look similar. Use the live view to compare wall color, gloss, and rim features rather than relying only on front-back position to identify which is upper or lower.
- Choose an unobstructed rim section, put one finger inside and one outside the bowl, and grip the inner and outer walls below the rim with the finger pads. Match the opening to wall thickness and surrounding clearance. Before closing, confirm the fingers actually straddle the wall to avoid pressing only the rim top and slipping.
- Keep the bowl opening upward during transport, leaving enough height for its bottom to pass over the rim of the other bowl. Avoid hitting the rim or the condiment bottle to the left of the bowls while moving laterally.
- Lower the upper bowl slowly toward the lower one. If one side of the rim contacts first, lift slightly and correct the horizontal position instead of pushing it straight, which could slide or tip the lower bowl.
- When gripping the upper bowl, keep the outer finger shallow near the rim to minimize intrusion between bowls. Release only after the lower bowl supports it, leaving space to withdraw fingers upward to avoid trapping fingers or lifting the bowl.
